## Problem statement

What problem does this solve, or what opportunity does it capture? Avoid jumping straight to the solution here.

## Proposed solution

What you're suggesting, at whatever level of detail you have.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you didn't prefer them (if any).

## Business value

- [ ] 5 — Directly enables a core platform capability or client-facing deliverable
- [ ] 3 — Meaningfully improves an existing capability
- [ ] 1 — Nice-to-have improvement, low urgency

## Related epic / user story

Link to an existing [epic](../../epics/) or [user story](../../user-stories/) if this extends tracked work, or note that this would be a new one.

## Additional context

Mockups, references, or related discussions.
